title: Nintendo DS: the plan is on file
body: The Nintendo DS network is planned together with the Wii's: one GameSpy-style foundation covers both systems, and it is written down as the future layer rather than started. Nothing in-house serves the DS today, and we will not pretend otherwise. What exists is the decision, the base and the order of work: Wii U and 3DS first, Switch running now, and the older handhelds following with the same account core behind them.
footer: OpenPak — open network services for your console.
